csv_project_name: AE for Downtown Revitalization Initiative Round 10
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Lackawanna (the City) is seeking proposals from qualified engineering consulting firms to assist with the preparation and submission of an application for Round 10 of the New York State Downtown Revitalization Initiative (DRI). The selected consultant will provide subject matter expertise, planning support, engineering design, and related analysis to strengthen the City s DRI application and enhance its competitiveness for funding consideration.Working in close partnership with the City of Lackawanna Department of Development, and under the direction of the Director of Development, the selected consultant will provide support services including, but not limited to, the following: A. Project Identification & Development Assist in identifying and refining priority projects Evaluate project feasibility and readiness Develop conceptual engineering approaches and recommendations B. Engineering & Concept Analysis Prepare preliminary design concepts Conduct infrastructure assessments Develop planning-level cost estimates and budgets Identify environmental and regulatory considerations C. Application Support Assist in drafting technical narratives and supporting documentation Develop maps, graphics, figures, and visualizations Assist with benefit analysis and project justification Ensure alignment with DRI evaluation and scoring criteria D. Stakeholder Coordination Participate in meetings with City administration, department heads, community stakeholders, and, as needed, members of the City Council Provide technical expertise and subject matter input during public engagement efforts E. Schedule & Deliverables Work within application deadlines established by New York State, with the ability to commence engagement with the City of Lackawanna on Monday, June 22, 2026, to initiate project planning and scheduling discussions, Provide draft and final materials required for submission
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Housing & Urban Development, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Urban Studies/Planning/Design, Graphic Design/Public Art
title: AE for Downtown Revitalization Initiative Round 10
short_description: Consulting services to prepare and strengthen Lackawanna's downtown revitalization funding application.
project_scope: Support for the City of Lackawanna's application to New York State Downtown Revitalization Initiative Round 10, including project identification and refinement, feasibility and readiness evaluation, conceptual engineering approaches, preliminary design concepts, infrastructure assessments, planning-level cost estimates, environmental and regulatory considerations, technical narratives, maps and visualizations, benefit analysis, and stakeholder coordination.
services: Engineering consulting, planning support, conceptual engineering design, infrastructure assessment, planning-level cost estimating, application preparation support, graphics/visualization, and stakeholder coordination.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an application support, planning, and downtown revitalization consulting assignment.
- No defined building, bridge, roof, stadium, or special structural project is identified.
- Scope centers on urban development strategy, feasibility, narratives, and stakeholder support rather than structural engineering design.
- Matches excluded categories such as pure urban/open space planning and planning/master planning.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice concerns preparation of a funding application and conceptual support for potential future projects, so no realistic project-specific construction cost can be derived from the documents.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The procurement is for consulting support for a DRI application, with no stated budget, fee schedule, or estimated contract value.
references_qualifications: Qualified engineering consulting firms with subject matter expertise in planning support, engineering design, related analysis, and downtown revitalization application preparation; no specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: City of Lackawanna, Department of Development, Erie County, New York, USA. Contact: Charles Clark. Email: lackawannadevelopment@lackny.com. Phone: 716-827-6475. Website: https://lackawannany.gov/
notes: Although the target market is listed as General Building, the tender is not for a specific building project but for downtown revitalization application support.
